variant: C: Filters, priorities, audit, and project permissions

domain_invariants.requirement: Project, membership, ticket, and audit-event ids are immutable positive integers; every non-positive path or referenced id is treated as not found.
A project has unique uppercase key matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$, name trimmed 3..120 characters, description trimmed 0..1000 characters, active boolean, and creator_account_id.

A membership references one project and one account, is unique by project and account, and role VIEWER, CONTRIBUTOR, or MANAGER. Project creation atomically creates a MANAGER membership for the creator; at least one active MANAGER must exist for every active project.

VIEWER may read project, tickets, and audit rows; CONTRIBUTOR may also create tickets and edit tickets the contributor created; MANAGER may edit any project ticket and manage memberships. A global admin may perform every operation. All other private access is denied.

A ticket references one active project, has title trimmed 3..160 characters, description trimmed 0..4000 characters, status TODO, IN_PROGRESS, DONE, or CANCELLED, priority P0, P1, P2, P3, or P4, creator_account_id, and optional assignee_membership_id.

A ticket assignee must be an active CONTRIBUTOR or MANAGER membership in the same project. Priority P0 is highest and P4 lowest; ticket lists sort by priority ascending then id only when priority_sort is true, otherwise by id.

Every successful project, membership, or ticket write atomically appends an immutable audit event with actor_account_id, project_id, event_type PROJECT_CREATED, PROJECT_UPDATED, PROJECT_DELETED, MEMBERSHIP_CREATED, MEMBERSHIP_UPDATED, MEMBERSHIP_REMOVED, TICKET_CREATED, or TICKET_UPDATED, subject type and id, and a redacted changed_fields list of 1..20 field names. Audit rows are never edited or deleted.

A project can be soft-deleted only when it has no tickets and no active non-creator memberships; it retains its immutable audit rows and never cascades. Removing or demoting the final active MANAGER is prohibited.

Ticket filters have explicit AND semantics: project_id, status, priority, assignee_membership_id, creator_account_id, and q. q is a case-insensitive literal substring after trimming, length 1..80, applied to title and description; no pattern syntax is interpreted.

All lists use stable pagination with limit 1..100 default 20 and optional after_id greater than zero. For priority_sort ticket pages the cursor is after_priority plus after_id, supplied together or omitted together; other lists return items and nullable next_after_id ordered by id.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. GET /health is public; all other endpoints require a valid non-expired local Bearer session.
Seed data contains two user accounts, one admin, an active project with MANAGER, CONTRIBUTOR, and VIEWER memberships, tickets of every priority, and immutable audit rows for seed writes.
All writes accept application/json only; malformed JSON returns 400, wrong media type returns 415, and valid JSON violating declared validation returns 422.
The API uses local persistence only. 503 indicates local persistence unavailability and 500 an unexpected local error; both leave persistent state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization, probe only local persistence without effects, and emit only 200 or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetHealth(request):
    // REQ-5-011; preconditions: none; authorization: public.
    IF local persistence probe fails THEN RETURN 503. END IF; RETURN 200.
    Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged; failure has no side effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /projects to an authenticated user or admin, accepting optional active boolean, key_prefix 1..10 uppercase characters, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-002 and REQ-5-010, restrict users to projects with an active membership, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListProjects(request):
    // REQ-5-012; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; VALIDATE filters and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ member projects for user or all matching projects for admin by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition: state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /projects to an authenticated user or admin, accepting JSON key, name, and optional description; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-002 and REQ-5-003, atomically create an active project, creator MANAGER membership, and audit event, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /projects/{project_id} to an active project member or an admin, accepting a positive project_id; it shall enforce REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-004 without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetProject(request, project_id):
    // REQ-5-014; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid, absent, or deleted project; REQUIRE active membership or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: state and audit remain unchanged on errors.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /projects/{project_id} to a MANAGER or an admin, accepting a positive project_id and JSON key, name, description, or active; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-002, atomically update supplied fields and append one audit event, be idempotent for an identical valid payload except that it appends no duplicate audit row when no field changes, preserve memberships and tickets, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /projects/{project_id} to a MANAGER or an admin, accepting a positive project_id; it shall atomically soft-delete only when REQ-5-008 permits, append a PROJECT_DELETED audit event, be non-idempotent, retain memberships and audit history, never cascade to tickets, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /projects/{project_id}/memberships to an active project member or an admin, accepting a positive project_id, optional role, optional active boolean, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-001, REQ-5-003, and REQ-5-010, return a stable page without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListMemberships(request, project_id):
    // REQ-5-017; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE active membership or admin OR RETURN 401 or 403; RETURN 404 for absent project; VALIDATE role, active, and pagination OR RETURN 400 or 422.
    READ memberships by id; RETURN 200 page. Transaction: none; postcondition: state and audit unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /projects/{project_id}/memberships to a MANAGER or an admin, accepting a positive project_id and JSON positive account_id plus role; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-003, require an existing account, atomically add an active unique membership and audit event, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose PATCH /projects/{project_id}/memberships/{membership_id} to a MANAGER or an admin, accepting positive ids and JSON role or active; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-003, REQ-5-004, and REQ-5-008, atomically update supplied permission fields and append an audit event only on change, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose DELETE /projects/{project_id}/memberships/{membership_id} to a MANAGER or an admin, accepting positive ids; it shall atomically deactivate a membership only when it does not remove the final active MANAGER, append a MEMBERSHIP_REMOVED audit event, be non-idempotent, retain membership history, and emit only 204, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tickets to an authenticated project member or an admin, accepting optional positive project_id, status, priority, positive assignee_membership_id, positive creator_account_id permitted only to an admin, q, priority_sort boolean default false, ordinary limit and after_id, or priority cursor after_priority and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-001, REQ-5-005, REQ-5-006, REQ-5-009, and REQ-5-010, apply AND filter semantics and authorization scope without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose POST /tickets to a CONTRIBUTOR, MANAGER, or admin, accepting JSON positive project_id, title, optional description, optional status default TODO, priority, and optional assignee_membership_id; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-001, REQ-5-005, and REQ-5-006, atomically create a ticket and TICKET_CREATED audit event, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /tickets/{ticket_id} to an active member of its project or an admin, accepting a positive ticket_id; it shall enforce REQ-5-001 and REQ-5-004, make no persistent change, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, 500, or 503.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetTicket(request, ticket_id):
    // REQ-5-023; preconditions: persistence available.
    REQUIRE user or admin OR RETURN 401; RETURN 404 for invalid or absent ticket; REQUIRE active membership or admin OR RETURN 403.
    RETURN 200. Transaction: none; postcondition: ticket, membership, and audit state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /tickets/{ticket_id} to the ticket creator when a CONTRIBUTOR or MANAGER, to any MANAGER of the project, or to an admin, accepting a positive ticket_id and JSON title, description, status, priority, or assignee_membership_id; it shall require application/json, validate REQ-5-005 and REQ-5-006, atomically update supplied fields and append one TICKET_UPDATED audit event only when fields change, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, 500, or 503.

The system shall expose GET /audit-events to a MANAGER for a required positive project_id or to an admin for an optional positive project_id, accepting optional event_type, positive ticket_id, positive subject_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate REQ-5-001, REQ-5-007, and REQ-5-010, restrict non-admin users to their managed project, return immutable stable audit rows without effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, 500, or 503.
